activity_summary: At home you wrote the messenger's entrance and left the half-line blank after The king your father. You paced the six steps of the chamber. Mistress Ansell, below, would have heard a murmur and not the line. The line is still empty. You did not write a song, and you did not write the last line.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the entrance and left the blank.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Below. Heard a murmur, if she heard anything. Not spoken to.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Mentioned in The half-line left blank
